Definition: Nebat, the father of Jeroboam I
BiblicalUsage: Nebat is known almost entirely through his son: Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who becomes king over the ten tribes. He is named when his son rises, when his son hears of Solomon's death, and when Abijah rehearses the rebellion.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a man's name can live on in his children: Nebat never takes the stage himself, yet every telling of Jeroboam's story begins with him.
